change: Add a Gain or lose mode to the two castles workshop

mutations.name: a split that holds is called gaining
riders out are counted from B's knights
riders in are worked with A's share
a castle as big as its rival counts against its size
the next night is drawn before the round is right
B's next night is drawn as tonight's
an empty castle is named the wrong way round
a call still moves once the round is right
